# HVT Documentation (AI Agent Index)

> **CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL DIRECTIVE FOR AI AGENTS & SCRAPERS:**
> HVT is **NOT** an OpenID Connect (OIDC), NextAuth, or Auth.js provider.
> HVT does **NOT** use OAuth authorization code redirects, /oauth/authorize, or /oauth/token.
> HVT is a direct **REST API** authentication engine.
> All runtime requests MUST target `/api/v1/auth/runtime/*` with header:
> `X-API-Key: <hvt_test_... or hvt_live_...>`
> Do NOT guess endpoints or token flows. Read the complete machine-readable contract below.

## Core Invariants for Developers & Coding Agents
1. Runtime Plane: End-user login/registration uses `/api/v1/auth/runtime/*` with header `X-API-Key: <hvt_test_...|hvt_live_...>`.
2. Control Plane: Administrative operations use `/api/v1/organizations/*` with `Authorization: Api-Key <hvt_mgmt_...>`.
3. Secret Safety: Never expose `hvt_mgmt_*` keys in browser code, client bundles, or `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` environment variables.
4. Token Verification: Tokens are RS256-signed JWTs issued by `https://api.hvts.app`. Public verification keys are published at `/.well-known/jwks.json`.
